interpretation: Staggered populated fleet workload. Original reports and all failing cells are preserved. Initial/final population snapshots are not a measured concurrent runtime minimum; these synthetic receipts do not qualify production HyperFeed or MMHF.
selection: Regular non-symlink .json, .jsonl, .log files only; private-config.json and worker-[0-9]+.json excluded. No mappings, WAL, sockets, binaries or temporary files.
